# Interventional radiology rooms

!!! info "Definition"
    An interventional radiology procedure room is a specialised clinical room where minimally invasive procedures are performed using imaging such as X-ray, ultrasound, CT or MRI to guide diagnosis and treatment.

## Activity classification

Activity is limited to spells with a valid procedure in either of the following treatment specialties:

* Interventional radiology (811)
* Paediatric interventional radiology (280)

## Calculating capacity

#### Pathway: deriving workload

The primary procedure from each qualifying spell is used to estimate procedure hours using the assumed procedure time.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \text{Procedure hours}
    =
    \text{Procedures}
    \times
    \frac{\text{Procedure time (minutes)}}{60}
    $$

#### Operating model: converting workload to capacity

Calculate the required number of interventional radiology procedure rooms by dividing procedure hours by the product of the service's annual operational hours and the assumed utilisation rate.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \begin{aligned}
    &\text{Required interventional radiology rooms} \\
    &=
    \frac{\text{Procedure hours}}
    {\text{Annual operational hours} \times \text{Utilisation rate}}
    \end{aligned}
    $$

## Assumptions

Assumptions may apply to an individual subgroup, several subgroups or all groups.

| Subgroup | Assumption | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All groups | Procedure time | Pathway |
| All groups | Utilisation rate | Operational |
| All groups | Annual operational hours | Operational |
